title: Bandle: Guess The Song Games
summary: Bandle: The Ultimate Song Guessing Quiz & Music Trivia Challenge! You have to recognize a song, but there's a twist. You only start with a single instrument. Can you guess the song with the least number of instruments playing? "Bandle is the best Worldle-alike I've seen for a long while" - Tom Scott (Youtuber) "Bandle - Now we're talking! Something good bro!" - Nathan Stanz (Youtuber) Bandle has also caught the attention of Twitch personalities, including NorthernLion, theneedledrop and PooperNoodle, becoming a part of their daily gaming lineup. How to play this unique music trivia quiz: - Start with the rhythm: Listen to the drums and feel the beat. - Add the bass: Let the groove set in and take your best guess. - Add guitar, piano, and other instruments as the song builds up. - Can you guess the song without all instruments playing? Features: - Daily Challenge and hundreds of songs available! - Multiplayer mode! - Great variety of latest hit songs as well as songs from the 70s, 80s, 90s, 2000s and 2010s - Pop, Rock, Metal, R&B, Rap Hip-Hop, Hard Rock, Easy listening, Country, latin, alternative, funk, Movie theme and more! - Musical Mastery: Learn to identify songs by their individual instruments. - 9 Extra trivia quiz games to enjoy with friends and family: - Can you complete the song's lyrics? - Spot the performer from photos. - Identify the band's lead member. - Guess where the artist hails from. - Answer trivia quiz questions about the songs. - Guess the song from the same year. - Guess the name of the album. - Guess the song with the same BPM. - Identify the song with similar instruments. Whether you're a music lover or just seeking a unique way to enjoy a quiz night with friends, Bandle offers a symphonic blend of challenge and quiz entertainment. Download now and start your song guessing journey!

title: QSO One
summary: QSO One puts the amateur radio voice networks you already use in one app, on your iPhone and your Mac. Connect to AllStarLink nodes (including HamVOIP and IAX Direct), EchoLink stations and conferences, DMR talkgroups (BrandMeister, TGIF, FreeDMR, System X, DMR+, ADN, AmComm, VKDMR, BC-TRBO, HamThings and more), NXDN talkgroups, M17 reflectors, System Fusion YSF and FCS rooms, D-STAR reflectors (REF, XRF, DCS, XLX and URF) and P25 talkgroups. Talk with the on-screen button, a Bluetooth push-to-talk button or your Mac keyboard. QSO One has its own voice codecs built in, so no extra hardware is needed. Beacon is QSO One's own voice network: join rooms around the world, chat, send direct and group messages, and make QSO cards with other hams. Also in the app: • Net Finder: find nets by day, time and network, and set reminders • On the Net: see which nets are live and check in • Weather radio: listen to your local NOAA weather station • Favorites and logins sync between your devices when you turn sync on • 13 languages and full VoiceOver support A valid amateur radio license is required to transmit on the radio networks, and each network needs your own callsign and login. Without a callsign you can still explore QSO One in browsing-only mode. Supporter subscriptions (optional): Spark, Carrier and Beacon, monthly. Every tier gets the Supporter badge. The Beacon tier includes one hosted Beacon room, and extra rooms can be added. Subscriptions renew monthly until you cancel them in your Apple account settings. Networks today: AllStarLink, IAX Direct, EchoLink, DMR, NXDN, M17, System Fusion, D-STAR, P25 and Beacon, and more coming. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://qso1.net/privacy

title: Fortune Tiles:Lunar Match Game
summary: Celebrate the Lunar New Year with Fortune Tiles, an exciting and fun match-three puzzle game filled with symbols of prosperity and good luck! Immerse yourself in vibrant visuals as you swipe and match tiles featuring iconic Lunar New Year elements like lanterns, dragons, and gold coins. Match at least 3 symbols to clear rows and columns, triggering powerful combos and boosters as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Collect fortune-filled rewards, unlock new festive tiles, and experience the joy of the Lunar New Year with every match! Get ready for endless fun, addictive gameplay, and a celebration of good fortune. Start your journey today and bring luck your way with Fortune Tiles!

title: OutBrick: Slide Block Puzzle
summary: OutBrick is a beautiful slide block puzzle game: slide each brick along its lane and out through the gate of its color. 2,376 hand-tuned puzzle levels across 198 toy-brick villages make a calm, clever brain teaser that trains your logic, planning and memory, with no timer and every level playable offline. If you enjoy block jam, unblock, color sort, parking and traffic escape puzzle games, OutBrick gives you a fresh challenge on every board. HOW TO PLAY • Drag a brick and it follows your finger along its lane and glides around corners. One drag is one move. • Guide each brick to the gate of its own color and watch it leave the board. • Long, tall, L and T-shaped bricks move as one piece and need a gate wide enough to let them through. • Some gates start frozen behind frosted glass. Each shows a countdown of bricks: clear that many and it thaws to reveal its color. • Every board has a move budget instead of a clock, so you can stop, think and plan at your own pace. A REAL LOGIC PUZZLE CHALLENGE Which brick goes first? Which gate opens next? Every board is packed full, and the move budget is tight, so every drag counts. New pieces keep arriving as you travel: sealed bricks, lifts, key gates, crates, chains, dispensers, pistons, garages, arrow bricks, hedges, jelly, boulders, bumpers, rails, mirror twins and more. Hard, Super Hard and Boss levels wear their own colors when you want a true test. HELPERS FOR TOUGH BOARDS Bombs, rockets and the rainbow burst bricks of any shape to open a crowded board. The UFO thaws a frozen gate or opens a sealed brick, hints point to a good next move, and undo takes one back. QUICK PLAY Clear a level and the next one slides in at once with a smooth animation and a gentle haptic, so a good run keeps its momentum. The friends celebrate with you at the end of each village. A JOURNEY MAP FULL OF LIFE Follow the road from Garden City through farms, seaside towns, snowy peaks, Haunted Hollow and thirty frontier villages, from Builder's Brickyard to Jigsaw Junction. Each village is built stud by stud with its own scenery, landmark and signature board shape. Earn stars, open village gifts and climb each village's star ladder. MEET FIVE BRICK FRIENDS Pix, Luna, Brix, Nova and Max travel the road with you. On devices with Apple Intelligence, your friend shares short tips and cheers about your board, written on your device. LIVE GAMES AND REWARDS • Village Race and Crew Race: clear new levels before the other racers. • Brick Royale: stay in the round and share the prize pot. • Friend Rescue, the Stamp Card, Brick Cinema and the Brick Wheel. • Weekly Missions, the Brick Pass reward track, the Scoreboard and your Collection. ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN Widgets show your Journey, your races and the Brick Puzzle of the Day, a mini slide puzzle you solve right in the widget. Follow a race live on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Ask Siri to play a level, find levels in Spotlight and use Shortcuts. PLAY YOUR WAY OutBrick wears Apple's Liquid Glass design on iPhone and iPad. VoiceOver describes every brick, gate and move. Optional color shapes on bricks and gates, high contrast, a left-handed tray, hold to confirm, idle hints and calm mode are in Settings, alongside support for Larger Text, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast. Progress syncs through iCloud, and Game Center keeps your achievements and leaderboards. CLEAR ABOUT CHOICE OutBrick offers optional in-app purchases for coins, boosters, lives and extras. Lives and move budgets are part of the game. Rewarded videos are optional and always started by you: no banner ads and no automatic ads between levels. An internet connection is needed for purchases, videos and online features, never to play the levels. Optional game analytics is your choice in Settings, and declining never limits gameplay, rewards or purchases. One brick, one clever drag, one village at a time: find your next satisfying clear.

title: Accessible Virtual Machine (AVM)
summary: AVM lets you install and run Windows 11 on your Mac entirely with VoiceOver, with no sighted help. It also supports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS for ARM. Recent versions add support for USB devices and update themselves automatically. It's free and open source.

title: TurnOver
summary: TurnOver is a free, open-source screen reader for the Mac that works alongside VoiceOver. It sits in the menu bar and takes over from VoiceOver in the apps you choose, such as Mail, Safari, Terminal, and Microsoft Word. Much of its design comes from NVDA, with browse mode for web pages and email, single-letter quick navigation, find, say all, and an elements list. It also understands VoiceOver's own commands. Switch to any other app and VoiceOver comes straight back.

title: Pikomofu - Cozy Virtual Pet
summary: For everyone who loves dogs and cats. A tiny pixel dog or cat lives in a little garden on your iPhone. The sky follows the real time of day and the seasons, and your pet spends its days at its own gentle pace. I love animals more than anything, and I made this calming little app with all my heart, for everyone who loves them too. If you have ever lived with a dog or a cat, you will catch small moments that make you smile and say "they really do that!" I won't explain them. Please just give it a try, and find them yourself. - One pet is free. No ads, no subscriptions. - New friends and accessories will keep coming, always free. - Pikomofu Pass, a one-time purchase, adds Apple Watch, widgets and up to 5 pets.

title: Dozo: Pill Reminder & Tracker
summary: Dozo is a simple reminder for anyone who takes pills, vitamins or injections and doesn't want to miss a dose. Set it up for yourself, or for a parent, in a few minutes. One move from the Lock Screen When a reminder arrives, choose Taken, Skip or Snooze right in the notification, without opening the app. With VoiceOver, these are in the rotor. Every kind of schedule • Set times every day • Every 8 hours and other intervals: pick the first time, the rest follow • Certain weekdays, every few days, or cycles like 21 days on, 7 off • Weekly injections or every few weeks, with site rotation • Fixed-length courses, as-needed medications, tapering doses Hard to forget A missed dose is reminded again at the interval you choose. Today tells you clearly what's next and what's late. With Siri Say "I took my medicine in Dozo" or "What's my next medication in Dozo". For your doctor Share your history as a PDF or web page, and print your medication list. Privacy Your information stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Move to a new phone with a backup file. Easy for everyone No cluttered screens; each step asks one question. Dozo also works fully with VoiceOver, large text and Voice Control, and dose actions are available as buttons or menus and in the rotor. Free and Full Package Two active medications and all features are free. For more medications, get the Full Package with a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly subscription. Dozo does not give medical advice; ask your doctor or pharmacist about your medication. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://forali.app/dozo-privacy/

title: DownAudible
summary: DownAudible is a MacOS app that allows you to download selected books or your entire library in the best possible quality. It also allows you to convert your books to standard M4B files, with chapters and metadata intact, and you can even convert books to M4A or MP3 with a file per chapter. If you have a folder of audible files already, DownAudible will match them to your existing library so you don't have to download them again. You can also convert existing files, freeing them to be played on any device of your choosing where those files are supported.

title: Tripod — Podcast Player
summary: Tripod is a brand new podcast app designed to make it easy to stay up to date with your favourite shows. It’s built around an inbox for new episodes and queues for what you’re listening to. Audio & Playback Tripod has integrated EQ settings, can trim silence, and balance audio levels across episodes, for the smoothest listening experience. You can skip chapters or use the transcript to jump to a specific line. It also has an innovative playback scrubber that snaps to the starts of chapters, glides over skipped chapters, and uses haptic feedback for extra precision. Inbox The inbox is where new episodes arrive and you can decide whether to keep or ignore episodes. For the shows where you listen to every episode, you can send them straight to the queue. Queues Instead of playlists you have to manually manage, Tripod has automatic queues. There’s a main queue, favourites, shorts, in-progress, and each genre gets its own queue. There’s also a special queue called Someday, which lets you keep episodes that you know you want to listen to, but you don’t need to be reminded of every time you open the app. It’s ideal for podcasts discussing books or movies that you haven’t seen yet. Innovative Controls Building on decade of experience with Obscura, my award-winning camera app, Tripod uses haptics and gestures to create delightful interactions throughout the app. Intelligence On supported devices, Tripod will use Apple Intelligence to transcribe episodes, generate chapters, and determine hosts and guests for the shows you listen to, and even recommended other shows that they’ve guested on. Appearance Every view and control in Tripod is designed to adapt its appearance to what you’re listening to, making the app feel personal and vibrant. You can also choose a tint color or make the whole app monochrome if you prefer. There’s also a few app icon choices to best fit your Home Screen. Apple Watch Tripod has an Apple Watch companion app that lets you control what you listen to, skip chapters and change audio settings. Handy, or should I say… wristy? CarPlay Tripod also has a CarPlay app so you can drive safe while listening to what moves you. Well the car moves you. But art can also move you. Are podcasts not art? Who is to say. Shortcuts & Intents For the automation sickos, Tripod has actions for controlling playback and audio settings, getting and editing the contents of your queues and inbox, and more. Widgets Yeah. It’s got widgets too. Yeah, for your Home Screen! Spotlight Integration Quickly find your shows from anywhere on your device. Sleep Timers Time based or end of chapter or end of episode. And so much more. ———— Privacy Policy: http://benricemccarthy.com/tripod/privacy Terms of use: http://benricemccarthy.com/tripod/terms
